To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
camptothecins are able to uncouple cell growth and cell division.

camptothecins and actinomycins inhibit the multiplication and DNA synthesis of cultured chick embryo fibroblasts, and that the alkaloid camptotecin stimulates the activity of the mitochondrial enzymes of the treated cells.

camptothecine and actinomycine D, two inhibitors of DNA synthesis in mammalian cells, stimulate the activities of the enzymes in mitochondria but not in microsomes or plasma membranes of chick embryo cells in culture.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the effect of camptothecine on the activities per cell (specific activities) of the enzymes of various cellular organelles of chick embryo cells cultured in vitro.
the effect of the alkaloid camptohcin and of actinomycine D on the protein content and on the levels of the enzymes of different organelles of cultured chick embryo fibroblasts.
the effects of camptothecine and actinomycine on cultured chick embryo cells.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
camptothecine stimulates the mitochondrial enzymes and actinomcin D inhibits the protein synthesis and cell growth but does not stimulate the mitochondrial enzymes.
camptothecins are not inhibitors of RNA polymerase and that the increase in protein content of the cells is not the result of the stimulation of the synthesis of the enzymes of protein synthesis.
the increase in mitochondrial enzymes activities in the presence of the drugs is a consequence of an increased number of mitochondria per cell, and not a consequence of a higher specific activity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
camptothecins stimulate the synthesis of proteins of the mitochondria, and that this stimulation precedes that of the proteins of the other organeles.
the alkaloid camptohcin stimulates mitochondrial enzymes and that this stimulation is independent of DNA synthesis.
the alkaloid camptohcicn stimulates the synthesis and activity of the mitochondrial enzymes in cultured chick embryo cells.
The main takeaway from our work is that

camptothecins are a new class of anticancer drug with a unique mechanism of action, which is to uncouple the growth and the division of cancer cells, and that camptothcin can induce the synthesis of new proteins in cancer cells.
